exercises.question: Which interview answer by the baker (*la panadera*) uses a stance opener accurately with gender agreement and no stacking?
options: Para ser sincera, el primer año en la panadería fue muy duro.
Para ser sincero, el primer año en la panadería fue muy duro.
Francamente, a decir verdad, el primer año en la panadería fue muy duro.
Para ser sincera el primer año en la panadería fue muy duro.

exercises.sentence: A _____ verdad, la clientela del barrio respondió mejor de lo que esperábamos.
exercises.english: To tell the truth, the neighbourhood clientele responded better than we expected.

exercises.sentence: _____ esto, conviene escuchar a la panadera antes de sacar conclusiones.
exercises.english: That said, it is advisable to listen to the baker before drawing conclusions.

exercises.sentence: Con franqueza, la panadera aseguró que la clientela sostuvo el negocio durante el primer mes.
options: Frankly, the baker stated that the clientele supported the business during the first month.
Frankly, the baker stated that the clientele abandoned the business during the first month.
Frankly, the baker stated that the clientele supported the business during the first week.

exercises.question: Which expression introduces a balanced pivot after stating a difficulty ('that said')?
options: dicho esto
a decir verdad
con franqueza
para ser sincero

exercises.question: Why did the guest decide to leave her office job and open a bakery?
options: Because she wanted to work with her hands and bring traditional bread back to her neighbourhood.
Because her former company closed its offices and moved to another city.
Because she inherited an existing bakery from her family and did not want to sell it.

exercises.question: What does the guest admit was the hardest part of her first months?
options: Finding enough flour and ovens before the winter holidays began.
Getting up before dawn every day while managing orders and bills at the same time.
Convincing local radio stations to interview her about her new shop.

exercises.question: What anecdote does the guest share about a loyal customer?
options: A customer offered to invest money to open three more shops across the city.
A customer complained about the opening hours and stopped visiting the shop.
A neighbour arrived early on a rainy day with hot coffee to offer her help.

prompt.speaker: Carlos
prompt.text: ¿Te gustó la entrevista de radio con la panadera del barrio?

options: A decir verdad, me encantó: habló con franqueza y sin rodeos sobre su trabajo.
A decir verdad, francamente, me encantó: habló con franqueza y sin rodeos sobre su trabajo.
Para ser sincero, me encantó: habló con franqueza y sin rodeos sobre su trabajo.

exercises.english: In any case, the clientele values the baker's work.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses a stance adverb or opener with proper punctuation and function?
options: Con franqueza, no esperaba una respuesta tan positiva de la clientela.
Con franqueza no esperaba una respuesta tan positiva de la clientela.
Con franqueza no esperaba, una respuesta tan positiva de la clientela.
A decir verdad, francamente, no esperaba una respuesta tan positiva de la clientela.
